 Samsung Android Rumors 
 We've heard multiple rumors about the Samsung Galaxy S27 lineup's cameras in the past few months. Now we have new information detailing the camera setup of the S27 series, expected to include four models - the Galaxy S27, the Galaxy S27+, the Galaxy S27 Pro, and the Galaxy S27 Ultra .
 According to the source, the Samsung Galaxy S27 and Galaxy S27+ will share the same camera setup - a 50MP primary, 12MP ultrawide, 10MP 3x telephoto, and 12MP selfie.
 The primary camera will use either the Sony IMX955 or Samsung S5KGNG sensor, while the ultrawide camera will use Sony IMX564. The 3x telephoto unit will use Samsung's S5K3K1, and the selfie camera will use either the Sony IMX874 or Samsung S5K3LU.
 Samsung Galaxy S27 Pro's leaked CAD render (Source: OnLeaks and Android Headlines ) 
 The Samsung Galaxy S27 Pro and Galaxy S27 Ultra will have nearly identical camera setups. That's because they will feature the same primary, ultrawide, and selfie cameras, but their telephoto units will be different.
 The Galaxy S27 Ultra will feature a 50MP 5x telephoto camera, using either the Sony IMX855 or Samsung S5KJN3 sensor. The Galaxy S27 Pro, on the other hand, will come with a 10MP 3x telephoto camera using Samsung's S5K3LD sensor, which also powered the S26 Ultra 's 10MP 3x telephoto unit. This resolution is lower than the previously rumored 50MP 5x, 50MP 3.5x, and 12MP 3x configurations.
